name: default
_comment: Starting budget for an authenticated enterprise SaaS route on a mid-tier laptop.
metrics = MAXIMUM Lighthouse audit numericValue (ms, except CLS which is unitless).
resource_sizes_kb = MAXIMUM transfer size per resource type, in KiB, from the
resource-summary audit. warn_margin_pct = how close to a limit still warns.
Copy this next to the project and tune per route; a budget that never fails is
decoration, and a budget raised to make a build green is worse than none.
